sql:
SELECT
    dataflow.recordregistry,
    riskmanagement.riskassess,
    dataprofile.datasense
FROM dataflow dataflow
JOIN riskmanagement riskmanagement ON dataflow.recordregistry = riskmanagement.flowlink
JOIN dataprofile dataprofile ON dataflow.recordregistry = dataprofile.flowsign
WHERE riskmanagement.riskassess > 0.7
AND dataprofile.datasense IN ('High', 'Critical')
ORDER BY dataprofile.datasense, dataflow.recordregistry;

FROM cases

  OR visacls = 'H-1B1 Chile';
